trainer_contract.scope: same-body sparse joint-position or SE3 completion using authentic payload targets; does not create paired cross-body data
input_required: matching body JSON and successful serialized_payload_qc
trainer_contract.joint_index_order: original payload order; no remapping from labels or sorting names
trainer_contract.coordinate_contract: position_canonical / reach; root-relative canonical coordinates, Y up; no claim of meters or centimeters
trainer_contract.se3_rotation_contract: if used, own-joint T-pose-relative global rotation from global_rot6; not palm surface orientation or hardware tool frame
trainer_contract.root_and_non_endpoint_pose_channels: follow trainer mask; never fill unavailable channels as valid zeros
trainer_contract.on_metadata_missing: isolate endpoint-conditioned task for this body; emit unresolved_metadata; do not guess an index
trainer_contract.on_fk_qc_failed: quarantine the affected sequence/body from all fixed-offset pose training and evaluation
trainer_contract.on_no_valid_endpoint: isolate endpoint-conditioned task; separately validated reconstruction may remain eligible
trainer_contract.on_no_confirmed_hand: use real topology leaves labeled generic_leaf; do not rename them hands
trainer_contract.split_source_of_truth: payload split and source_group_index after content-deduplication; policy never re-splits frames

validate_topology: Require original names length J, parents length J, one root at index 0 and parent before child.
Recompute non-root leaves from parents and require exact equality with adapter ee_indices.
Require finite positive reach and successful per-sequence FK and serialized payload QC.
A candidate must have valid finite target position in every sampled frame and nonzero cumulative rest-path length from the root (> 1e-8 canonical body units).

hand_candidates.normalization: Keep raw name for provenance; strip optional namespace up to last colon; split CamelCase and separators into lowercase tokens; numeric export suffixes are ignored for matching only.
candidate_priority: unambiguous named hand anchor with arm-chain evidence
hand_candidates.ambiguity_policy: If more than one equally valid anchor remains on a side, mark that side unresolved; do not select an arbitrary index.
hand_candidates.two_sided_strategy: When exactly one verified left and one verified right anchor exist, prefer conditioning both; one of that pair may be used in a separately labeled single-hand task.
hand_candidates.single_sided_strategy: When only one verified hand/wrist anchor exists, condition that single anchor and label single_hand_anchor.
hand_candidates.side_unknown_strategy: Do not invent left/right; a single unambiguous confirmed anchor may be single_hand_anchor with side unknown; multiple side-unknown candidates fall back to leaves.

leaf_fallback.candidate_indices: sorted non-root topology leaves passing geometric and sample-validity checks
leaf_fallback.generic_means: a real named or unnamed skeleton leaf, not a claim of functional anatomy
leaf_fallback.one_leaf_strategy: condition the one actual leaf; no duplicated second endpoint
leaf_fallback.two_or_more_leaf_strategy: select one or two distinct real leaf indices with a deterministic seeded sampler; record exact indices and raw names for the sample
leaf_fallback.zero_valid_leaves: unavailable_endpoint_condition; do not substitute root, a random joint, or zeros
leaf_fallback.anatomic_subtype: unknown unless separately verified; feet, wings, legs and tails remain non-hand labels
